english:
## How do I check my face shape?

1. Push your hair off your forehead.
2. Find the widest part: forehead, cheekbones or jaw.
3. Compare the length of your face with its width.
4. Match what you see to the table.

| Face shape | How to tell | Try |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Oval | A bit longer than wide, soft jaw | Almost any style |
| Round | Length and width about the same, soft jaw | Height on top: Quiff, Faux Hawk, Brush Up |
| Square | Strong, wide jaw | Short, neat cuts: Crew Cut, Classic Side Part |
| Long | Much longer than wide | A fringe or fuller sides: French Crop, Caesar Cut, Two-Block |
| Heart | Wide forehead, narrow chin | A fringe, and more beard at the chin: Side Fringe, Full Beard |

where: P05 Haircuts for thin hair or a receding hairline
english:
## Why does short hair look thicker?

Long hair separates and lies flat, so the scalp shows between strands. Short hair stands up and looks denser.

## Which cuts work best?

- **[French Crop](/styles/french-crop) and [Crop Fade](/styles/crop-fade):** the fringe covers the front
- **[Caesar Cut](/styles/caesar-cut):** a short, straight fringe
- **[Buzz Cut](/styles/buzz-cut) or [Head Shave](/styles/head-shave):** no contrast between thin and thick areas

## Which product should I use?

Dry wax (clay). Shiny wax and heavy gel make hair clump together, which shows more scalp.

## When should I see a doctor?

Shedding 50–100 hairs a day is normal, and in men about 95% of hair loss is male pattern baldness, according to experts quoted by [USA Today](https://www.aol.com/fast-does-hair-actually-grow-090116698.html). See a doctor if hair falls out suddenly, in patches, or with an itchy or sore scalp.
translation:
## छोटो कपाल किन बाक्लो देखिन्छ?

लामो कपाल छुट्टिन्छ र चेप्टो बस्छ, त्यसैले लटहरूबीच टाउकोको छाला देखिन्छ। छोटो कपाल ठाडो रहन्छ र बाक्लो देखिन्छ।

## कुन कट सबैभन्दा राम्रो?

- **[French Crop](/styles/french-crop) र [Crop Fade](/styles/crop-fade):** फ्रिन्जले अगाडि ढाक्छ
- **[Caesar Cut](/styles/caesar-cut):** छोटो, सिधा फ्रिन्ज
- **[Buzz Cut](/styles/buzz-cut) वा [Head Shave](/styles/head-shave):** पातलो र बाक्लो भागबीच फरक देखिँदैन

## कुन प्रोडक्ट प्रयोग गर्ने?

ड्राई वाक्स (क्ले)। चम्किलो वाक्स र गह्रौं जेलले कपाल डल्लो पार्छन्, जसले बढी छाला देखाउँछ।

## डाक्टरलाई कहिले देखाउने?

[USA Today](https://www.aol.com/fast-does-hair-actually-grow-090116698.html) ले उद्धृत गरेका विशेषज्ञहरूका अनुसार दिनमा 50–100 वटा कपाल झर्नु सामान्य हो, र पुरुषमा करिब 95% कपाल झर्ने समस्या पुरुष ढाँचाको टाउको खुइलिने (male pattern baldness) हो। कपाल अचानक, ठाउँ-ठाउँमा, वा टाउको चिलाउने वा दुख्नेसँगै झरे डाक्टरलाई देखाउनुहोस्।

where: P06 Clipper numbers explained: how to ask your barber
english: Clipper guard numbers tell the barber how much hair to leave. Machine #0 leaves about 0.5–1 mm, #1 leaves 3 mm, #2 leaves 6 mm, #3 leaves 10 mm and #4 leaves 13 mm. Saying "sides #2, top 2 fingers" is much clearer than "short on the sides".

where: P06 Clipper numbers explained: how to ask your barber
english:
## What does each number leave?

| Machine | Hair left | Looks like |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #0 | 0.5–1 mm | Skin shows through |
| #1 | 3 mm | Scalp visible |
| #2 | 6 mm | Very short and even |
| #3 | 10 mm | Short |
| #4 | 13 mm | Short but soft |
| #8 | 25 mm | Short to medium |

These are the most common guard sizes. Brands can differ by about a millimetre.

## What does "fingers" mean?

Barbers measure the top by finger width. One finger is about 2 cm of hair, so "2 fingers" means about 4 cm.

## What should I say?

Give three things: the sides, the top and the finish. For example: "Sides #1 faded to #3, top 2 fingers, clean neck line."
translation:
## कुन नम्बरले कति छोड्छ?

| मेसिन | बाँकी कपाल | कस्तो देखिन्छ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #0 | 0.5–1 mm | छाला देखिन्छ |
| #1 | 3 mm | टाउकोको छाला देखिन्छ |
| #2 | 6 mm | धेरै छोटो र बराबर |
| #3 | 10 mm | छोटो |
| #4 | 13 mm | छोटो तर नरम |
| #8 | 25 mm | छोटोदेखि मध्यम |

यी सबैभन्दा चलेका गार्ड साइज हुन्। ब्रान्डअनुसार करिब एक मिलिमिटर फरक पर्न सक्छ।

## "औंला" भनेको के हो?

बार्बरहरूले माथिको कपाल औंलाको चौडाइले नाप्छन्। एक औंला भनेको करिब 2 cm कपाल, त्यसैले "2 औंला" भनेको करिब 4 cm।

## के भन्ने?

तीन कुरा भन्नुहोस्: छेउ, माथि र फिनिस। जस्तै: "छेउ #1 देखि #3 सम्म फेड, माथि 2 औंला, गर्दनको लाइन सफा।"

where: P07 How often should men get a haircut?
english: Every 2 to 8 weeks, depending on the style. Hair grows about half an inch (1.25 cm) a month, according to the American Academy of Dermatology Association. Fades and very short cuts lose their shape in 2–3 weeks, classic short cuts last 3–4 weeks, and medium or long hair needs a trim every 6–8 weeks.

## Does cutting make hair grow faster?

No. Trimming removes damaged ends but doesn't change how fast hair grows, a dermatologist told [USA Today](https://www.aol.com/fast-does-hair-actually-grow-090116698.html).

## When should I book before a wedding or festival?

One or two days before the wedding, Dashain or Tihar. A fresh fade can look too sharp on the same day. A day later it looks natural.

## Is hair dye safe?

Most reactions are mild, and serious ones are rare. Many permanent dyes contain PPD, a common cause of reactions. The [NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/hair-dye-reactions) advises testing the dye on a strand of hair at least 48 hours before, wearing gloves, and never leaving dye on longer than the packet says. Symptoms can take up to 72 hours to appear.

## Can I colour my beard too?

Yes. Turn on "Also colour beard and moustache" in My Look. The barber keeps dye away from your lips.

धेरैजसो प्रतिक्रिया हल्का हुन्छन्, गम्भीर प्रतिक्रिया दुर्लभ हुन्छन्। धेरै स्थायी डाईमा PPD हुन्छ, जुन प्रतिक्रियाको सामान्य कारण हो। [NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/hair-dye-reactions) ले कम्तीमा 48 घण्टाअघि कपालको एउटा लटमा डाई टेस्ट गर्न, पन्जा लगाउन, र प्याकेटमा लेखेभन्दा बढी समय डाई नराख्न सल्लाह दिन्छ। लक्षण देखिन 72 घण्टासम्म लाग्न सक्छ।

english:
## Which styles work best?

- **[Crop Fade](/styles/crop-fade) and [French Crop](/styles/french-crop):** the messy look is the style
- **[Buzz Cut](/styles/buzz-cut) and [Crew Cut](/styles/crew-cut):** nothing to flatten
- **[Curly Top Fade](/styles/curly-top-fade):** curls spring back

## Which styles struggle?

The [Pompadour](/styles/pompadour), [Quiff](/styles/quiff) and [Slick Back](/styles/slick-back) lose their height and shape under a helmet.

## How do I fix helmet hair fast?

1. Wet your fingertips lightly.
2. Rub a little dry wax (clay) between your palms.
3. Push the hair up and forward with your fingers.

## कुन स्टाइल सबैभन्दा राम्रो?

- **[Curly Top Fade](/styles/curly-top-fade):** घुम्रा फेरि उठ्छन्

## कुन स्टाइललाई गाह्रो हुन्छ?

[Pompadour](/styles/pompadour), [Quiff](/styles/quiff) र [Slick Back](/styles/slick-back) हेल्मेटमुनि उचाइ र आकार गुमाउँछन्।

## हेल्मेटले बिगारेको कपाल छिटो कसरी मिलाउने?

1. औंलाका टुप्पा हल्का भिजाउनुहोस्।
2. हत्केलामा थोरै ड्राई वाक्स (क्ले) मिच्नुहोस्।
3. औंलाले कपाल माथि र अगाडितिर धकेल्नुहोस्।
